examName: Microsoft 365 Copilot and Agent Administration Fundamentals
note: Domain weights reflect the skills-measured outline published on Microsoft Learn as of 2026-07-22. This exam is currently in beta; always check learn.microsoft.com for the current official breakdown before your exam, since beta exams can change quickly.

domains.name: Identify the core features and objects of Microsoft 365 services
subtopics: Core objects across the Microsoft 365, Exchange, SharePoint, and Teams admin centers
How license assignment affects feature access for users and groups
Zero Trust principles, authentication methods, and threat protection with Microsoft Defender XDR
Microsoft Entra ID features: conditional access, SSO, Identity Secure Score, audit logs, and Privileged Identity Management (PIM)

domains.name: Understand data protection and governance tasks for Microsoft 365 and Copilot
subtopics: Microsoft Purview capabilities: Information Protection, DLP, Insider Risk Management, Communication Compliance, DSPM for AI, Data Lifecycle Management
Sensitivity labels, data classification, and retention
How Copilot accesses data through Microsoft Graph and the permission model that protects against oversharing
Identifying and responding to data protection and governance risks (Compliance Manager, Data Explorer, DLP alerts, eDiscovery)
Detecting and remediating oversharing in SharePoint, including SharePoint Advanced Management

domains.name: Perform basic administrative tasks for Copilot and agents
subtopics: Built-in Copilot and agent capabilities, including Researcher and Analyst
Copilot licensing models: monthly per-user versus pay-as-you-go
Assigning licenses, monitoring usage and adoption, and managing prompts
Configuring agent access, creating agents, the approval process, and monitoring agent lifecycle
